# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Jacob Blesses Aseneth

---

**17:1** And Jacob came to Egypt in the second year of the famine, on the new moon of the fourth month, and Joseph went out to meet his father.

**17:2** And Joseph said to his father: 'Come in to Pentephres the priest of Heliopolis, for he has a daughter named Aseneth and she is my wife.' And Jacob said: 'Bring her to me, so that I may bless her.'

**17:3** And Aseneth came to Jacob and bowed before him. And Jacob looked at her and said: 'Come near, my daughter.' And he stretched out his right hand and placed it on her head and said: 'Blessed are you by the Lord God Most High.'

**17:4** 'And the Lord God will bless the man who is your husband forever and ever, and the Lord God will bless your sons and daughters who will come forth from you forever and ever.'

**17:5** And Jacob kissed Aseneth and took her right hand and brought her into the house of Joseph.

**17:6** And all the sons of Jacob came and bowed before Aseneth and said to her: 'Blessed is our sister, for our father our God has blessed you and God has established you forever.'

**17:7** And Simeon and Levi, the sons of Leah, loved Aseneth greatly above all the sons of Jacob. And they became friends together.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
